notes.title: FreedSoft V 1.0.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39545053/4f6377b9e54b5e8300a7296b77100383cac80a0f.png[/img]

[b]FreedSoft V 1.0.0[/b]

This version is the start of the restart of FreedSoft with the cooperative. This version has all the basic mechanics:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39545053/a7aa0ec42db15216bf7aedbb08b2e6fb9966ae3a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The main character
[*] Skills
[*] Vital signs
[*] Construction system
[*] Employees
[*] Training
[*] Micro contracts
[*] Creating your own software
[*] Marketing
[*] And to generate income from software
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39545053/38a2f470563139fce690f30baac19de6073c87a2.png[/img]

Although we were not able to show the cooperative version of the game, it will be released in the next patch. 
We will be very grateful for feedback and suggestions for development.

Also, you can always follow an even earlier version in beta, with the properties of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39545053/df6f1803b72f23c7d6398b9c8220489a3a5ba736.png[/img]

notes.title: Freed Soft Online
notes.content:
[b]Nothing has been heard about us for a long time. Freed Soft Online-play together with your friends. Since Freed Soft plans a huge number of mechanics, we decided to immediately create an online version of the game. Now we are rewriting the old version for online gameplay, but there is something new.  [/b]

notes.title: Version 0.0.5.0.6 " All from the beginning"
notes.content:
[b]We apologize for the lengthy update.[/b] This involves moving to a new office and adding a few staff (employee training).

[b]In version 0.0.5.0.6 made:[/b]
[list]
[*] Redrawn all game menus
[*] Adding custom character mechanics
[*] Added a new type of location "Home"
[*] Added functionality for employees
[*] Translated into English
[*] Fixed a bunch of bugs
[/list]
